properties.headline: Wildfire with IMMEDIATE EVACUATION for Scott and along the Caddo-Canadian County Line.
properties.description: At 1303  a large and destructive wildfire was burning out of control in northern Caddo County near Scott  spreading east-northeast rapidly. Wildfires can damage or destroy structures and can harm or kill people and animals. For your safety  EVACUATE IMMEDIATELY towards State Highway 37 to the north.
properties.instruction:
Those between CR 2670 and CR 2690/S Mayberry Road and SW 74th and CR 1130 should LEAVE this area NOW to avoid injury or death. Do not delay to pack belongings. 
Roads in the area may be impacted by fire and smoke. Never drive into heavy smoke. SLOW DOWN & MOVE OVER for emergency vehicles.

CMAMtext: Caddo Co. EVACUATION ORDER for a wildfire. LEAVE NOW to the north toward State Highway 37.
CMAMlongtext: Caddo Co EM: a large and destructive wildfire was burning out of control in northern Caddo County near Scott, spreading east-northeast rapidly. This area is in IMMEDIATE DANGER from wildfires which can cause injury/death, burn down homes/other structures. LEAVE NOW toward State Highway 37. Do not delay to pack belongings. Never drive into heavy smoke.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 15 at 12:35PM MDT until September 15 at 3:30PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
South Central Kane County in southern Utah...

* Until 330 PM MDT.

* At 1235 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of normally dry washes,
streams, and creeks.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Big Water, Wahweap Creek, and Coyote Creek.

This includes US Route 89 between mile markers 3 and 12.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 3:30 PM MDT. Avoid flooded areas.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 15 at 1:42PM MDT until September 15 at 4:45PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
South Central Kane County in southern Utah...

* Until 445 PM MDT.

* At 142 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across Buckskin Gulch, Wire Pass, and the Wave. Up to
0.75 inches of rain have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks, streams, slot
canyons, and normally dry washes.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Buckskin Gulch, Wire Pass, and the Wave.

This includes US Route 89 between mile markers 14 and 27.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Move to higher ground now. Act quickly to protect your life.

Remain alert for flooding even in locations not receiving rain. Dry
washes, streams, and rivers can become raging killer currents in a
matter of minutes, even from distant rainfall.
